subject: Compact technical walkthrough sprint — SOC2 scope & DPA handoff
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@argentum.com>
To: ava.chen@redwoodinference.com
Cc: julia.moore@argentum.com, eli.torres@argentum.com
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compact technical walkthrough request — SOC2 scope + DPA review

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the intro. We are preparing for our FY26 compliance intake and would like to run a compact technical walkthrough with Redwood focused on SOC 2 control mapping, a high-level pen-test scope discussion, and a quick DPA handoff so our legal team can track redlines. We anticipate 45–60 minutes should cover it if we keep to a tight agenda: introductions, architecture & data flows, encryption/data residency, pen-test scoping, and DPA next steps.

Are you available next week for a short sprint? Our preferred windows (UTC) are:
- Tue 16 Sep, 14:00–17:00 UTC
- Wed 17 Sep, 09:00–12:00 UTC
- Thu 18 Sep, 13:00–16:00 UTC

Attendees from our side will include Eli Torres (Security), Julia Moore (Legal) and one engineer. I’ve attached our intake form (Argentum-Security-Intake_Form.xlsx) — please confirm if you need anything else ahead of time (pre-read, evidence bundle, etc.).

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Head of Information Security
Argentum Financial
(attach: Argentum-Security-Intake_Form.xlsx)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@argentum.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact technical walkthrough request — SOC2 scope + DPA review

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the intake and the suggested windows.

On Thu, Sep 11, 2025 at 3:12 PM Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@argentum.com> wrote:
> Hi Ava,
> 
> Thanks for the intro. We are preparing for our FY26 compliance intake...

We can absolutely run a tight 45-minute technical sprint to cover the bullets you listed. Proposed slots from our side (PT / UTC offsets included):
- Tue 16 Sep, 08:00–08:45 PT (15:00–15:45 UTC)
- Wed 17 Sep, 11:00–11:45 PT (18:00–18:45 UTC)
- Thu 18 Sep, 06:00–06:45 PT (13:00–13:45 UTC)

Quick notes:
- We’ll send a short pre-read (SOC2-Controls-Summary.pdf) and an annotated copy of the DPA with our comments (DPA-annotated-v1.docx) before the meeting.
- Ben will take notes and own follow-up items / mutual action plan.
- If the pen-test vendor needs onboarding, we typically carve out a separate 30-min vendor sync the week after the walkthrough.

Can you confirm which of your suggested windows works for you and who will join from Legal/Engineering? Once you confirm, I’ll send an invite with a short agenda and attach the pre-read.

Best,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com
(Desk: +1 415-555-0193)

(attachments to follow: SOC2-Controls-Summary.pdf, DPA-annotated-v1.docx)

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@argentum.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Julia Moore <julia.moore@argentum.com>, Eli Torres <eli.torres@argentum.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact technical walkthrough request — SOC2 scope + DPA review

Ava — thanks, that sounds good.

We’ll take the Thu 18 Sep, 13:00–13:45 UTC slot (your Thu 06:00–06:45 PT option). Confirmed attendees:
- Eli Torres (Security Lead)
- Julia Moore (Senior Counsel)
- Marco Diaz (Platform Engineer)

A couple of asks ahead of the call:
- Could you include a simple data-flow slide or two showing where customer data is stored and returned (purpose-built diagrams are most helpful for our engineering team)?
- We’d like to review how you run pen tests: do you prefer a vendor-first onboarding or do you accept vendor artifacts and coordinate remotely?
- Please provide the pre-read and any sample evidence on encryption keys and rotation policies.

I attached a tiny attendee export so I can forward to legal internally if needed (Argentum-Attendees.csv).

Thanks — Julia will also log any DPA redline items in DocuSign; if you can send a link to your current DPA draft that would speed things up.

—Sanjay
(attach: Argentum-Attendees.csv)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@argentum.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact technical walkthrough request — SOC2 scope + DPA review

Perfect — Thu 18 Sep, 13:00–13:45 UTC is locked in. I’ve attached the calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) and the SOC2-Controls-Summary.pdf pre-read.

On Fri, Sep 12, 2025 at 8:20 AM Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@argentum.com> wrote:
> Ava — thanks, that sounds good.
> 
> We’ll take the Thu 18 Sep, 13:00–13:45 UTC slot...

Quick answers to your questions:
- We’ll add two simple data-flow slides to the pre-read; see pages 3–4 of SOC2-Controls-Summary.pdf for a compact view.
- For pen tests: we can both onboard vendors or accept vendor reports depending on the test type. If Argentum intends to use a single third-party vendor for external network tests, we recommend a short vendor-sync after the walkthrough to exchange scope & IP allowlists.
- DPA: forwarding a DocuSign link for the current DPA (https://www.docusign.com/sign?DPA_v3). Please ask Julia to add redlines there and Ben will coordinate internal review.

Action items:
- Redwood: attach pre-read and calendar invite (done). Ben will capture the mutual action plan during the call.
- Argentum: confirm any additional attendees and populate DPA redlines in DocuSign before the call if possible.

Thanks — look forward to it.

Best,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com
(attachments: calendar-invite.ics, SOC2-Controls-Summary.pdf)
